WhatsApp Business API

Put WhatsApp inside your CRM.

How it works, the three rules to design around, and how to start.

App vs Platform
AppA person chatting from a phone. Free. Limited agents, basic quick replies.
APIYour CRM sends and receives messages. Many agents, bots, routing, full logging.

Rule 1
24h

The service window.

When a customer messages you, you can reply freely for 24 hours. Every new message from them restarts the clock.

Rule 2

Outside the window, use templates.

Meta reviews and approves them first. Categories include marketing, utility and authentication, and the category affects the price.

Rule 3

Opt-in first. Always.

Customers must agree to hear from you on WhatsApp. Store that consent in your CRM and make opting out easy.

What the integration does
01Logs every message to the right contact and deal
02Routes new chats to the right salesperson
03Sends confirmations, reminders, payment links
04Captures leads from click-to-WhatsApp ads
05Shows full history to whoever picks up next

Getting started
01Verify your Meta Business account
02Pick a number not already on WhatsApp
03Cloud API directly, or a solution provider
04Submit your first templates
05Connect to your CRM, test with real chats

Customers already on WhatsApp?

Make it part of your CRM, not a side channel.

We build custom CRMs with WhatsApp at the centre.
